page.overview:
Who is Bartholomew?

Bartholomew existed approximately 1000+ years into the future Ooo and was supposedly "built" by Marceline (or as she was later known: "The Empress") from BMO's recycled parts. He and his brothers (Mingus and Orange Juice) had been tasked with retrieving found artifacts to the Empress as part of their allegiance to her.

Bartholomew stood approximately two and 1/3 of Finn's height (based off of the comic book artwork) and had a rigid metallic build similar to his brothers. He had red circular eyes and four red telescopic arms.
